title: 19 December 1961: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
content:
The Beatles’ 67th lunchtime performance at Liverpool’s Cavern Club took place on this day.

The group’s lunchtime shows in the Cavern typically lasted from 12-2pm. Overall this was their 100th appearance at the Mathew Street cellar club, including their late-night shows.

Although the precise number of their Cavern performances is not known, The Beatles played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows at the Mathew Street venue between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

Also on this day...

  • 2024: Paul McCartney live: O2 Arena, London
  • 2011: Paul McCartney live: Manchester Evening News Arena, Manchester
  • 1974: George Harrison live: Madison Square Garden, New York City
  • 1974: Paul McCartney and George Harrison meet to dissolve The Beatles’ partnership
  • 1971: Travel: John Lennon – Houston to New York City
  • 1964: George Harrison and Pattie Boyd return from the Bahamas
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Star-Club, Hamburg
